sources: The Block, Nov 23 2026: DOJ civil forfeiture complaint in D.C. federal court seeks about $1.17B in USDC tied to the Oct 29 Binance hack, 36 addresses on 18 blockchains; Circle blocked access; TRO obtained Nov 12; DOJ: helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9B; Binance losses about $6.34B, fully replenished; Brett Leatherman (FBI Cyber operations director): 'Following the Binance theft, the FBI and our partners moved quickly to trace and freeze stolen assets.'

Cointelegraph, Nov 23 2026: DOJ seeks more than $1.1B held in USDC; nearly $3B frozen/seized/returned of $6B+; Binance committed $6.34B; Leatherman 'moved quickly to trace and freeze stolen assets'; Elliptic: $247M through mixers, 27,000+ wallets, 18,270 BTC taken directly has not moved
Decrypt, Nov 23 2026 (Elliptic): at least $247M into Bitcoin coinjoins; 18,270 BTC not moved since the hack; 27,000+ wallets
CoinDesk, Nov 23 2026: Binance hackers push $247M through coinjoins (Elliptic)
